title: F7 VALUES-COHERENCE LAYER: Nordic/Swiss norm internalization - think it and measure it
description: Operator directive (ruling 2.2): evaluate a values-coherence layer where collective values make misconduct INCOHERENT to agents, on the Nordic/Swiss model. Three strands feed a writer: (1) legitimacy and social-trust evidence (Tyler procedural fairness, Levi contingent consent, Rothstein QoG, Kleven Denmark tax compliance, WVS/ESS trust series, Swiss militia/communal embedding, plus the dark side: conformity costs, insider/outsider boundaries); (2) institutional theory of norms+sanctions complementarity (Ostrom design principles and graduated sanctions, Ellickson, Axelrod, Fehr-Gaechter punishment experiments, conditional cooperation); (3) in-harness measurement: define coherence metrics computable from events.jsonl/tasks/git TODAY and COMPUTE the baseline (voluntary DEVIATION disclosures vs discovered silent divergences, refusal events per volume, overrides with reasoned notes, unforced protocol compliance). Deliverable: docs/precedent-research/18-values-coherence-layer.md with theory, evidence, why in-context agents are unusually norm-sensitive, measured baseline, and the synthesis hypothesis for F7 v2 (values as rung zero, mechanical ladder as rarely-fired backstop). Writer claims, locks, U2 note, handoff; non-producer verifier replays.
acceptance_criteria: docs/precedent-research/18-values-coherence-layer.md exists with sections: legitimacy/trust evidence, norms+sanctions complementarity, the in-context-agent argument, measured in-harness baseline with method, honest limits (conformity costs; values do not stop a determined adversary), synthesis hypothesis for F7 v2
at least 10 distinct external sources cited inline; no emojis; no absolute user paths
the baseline section reports ACTUAL numbers computed from events.jsonl/tasks/git with the exact commands or method stated, plus the telemetry gaps that block a fuller index
the doc states explicitly what the values layer CANNOT do (determined adversary, sybil identities) so it cannot be read as replacing the mechanical ladder
verifier (non-producer) replayed doc against strand findings and re-ran at least two baseline computations before verdict
